text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [sev2] billing-metering token-count drift detected in eu-west-1. Spike: +1.5M tokens over last 30m vs baseline. Multiple customers flagged for overage. Pager ID: 5234. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift
alice: Taking ownership. Oncall here, joining. I'll gather quick telemetry and confirm customer impact. :rotating_light:
ben: looking at emitter logs now — tailing emitter-proxy in eu-west-1. running: kubectl logs -f svc/emitter-proxy -n prod --since=1h
carla: billing team sees ~12 customers with overage flags, most at 1.4–2x expected daily tokens. No billing invoices sent yet, just flags. listing top3…
dean: support pinged CSMs for top3 (acme, finco, shoply). No inbound tickets yet. Will escalate if customers reach thresholds.
alice: quick check: query token emit rate from kafka topic offsets
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes';
```
Result: ~+1.45M tokens. Also seeing bursts at 11:12, 11:27 UTC.
ben: I see a pattern — a proxy retry loop tied to 502 from upstream. Retries not idempotent: each retry re-emits tokens w/out dedup key. Example log:
```
[2026-03-17T11:12:03Z] emitter::send id=abc123 attempt=1 status=502
[2026-03-17T11:12:04Z] emitter::send id=abc123 attempt=2 status=502
[2026-03-17T11:12:05Z] emitter::send id=abc123 attempt=3 status=200
```
That triple-counts tokens for some requests.
eva: can we confirm KV cache/ack window? If emitter had ack window too small, retries may be allowed. Also check ingress load balancer spikes.
frank-support: If this is inflating counts we should suppress customer overage flags until dedupe is confirmed. Is there a safe window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
carla: We can mute the auto-flagging pipeline for eu-west-1 for 60 minutes — requires ops approval. That'll stop creating new overage alerts but won't change counts already emitted.
alice: mitigation plan:
1) Pause emitter-proxy retries (flip flag) in eu-west-1 (hotfix).
2) Restart emitter instances with dedupe key enabled (deploy patch).
3) Backfill dedup post-hoc to collapse duplicates in the ledger.
4) Mute auto-flags for 1h and notify CSMs.
5) Monitor token rate and customer alerts.
ben: Applying step 1 now — setting PROXY_RETRY_MAX=1 for svc/emitter-proxy, patching configmap.
ops-bot: configmap updated for svc/emitter-proxy in eu-west-1 by ben. rollout started.
ben: Restarting 3 emitter pods (rolling) — kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter -n prod --selector=region=eu-west-1
alice: after pod bounce, token ingestion rate down ~65% vs peak. baseline trending back. Still seeing small bursts but not full triples.
carla: Muting auto-flagging for eu-west-1 for 60m. Notifying billing ops and CSMs. :white_check_mark:
dean: Notified acme/finco/shoply CSMs with a heads-up. They'll relay if customers call.
luis: we should capture a snapshot of raw events for full dedupe/backfill. Creating S3 snapshot job now.
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-metrics/eu-west-1/events/2026-03-17/ /tmp/snapshot --recursive
```
frank-support: 👍 thanks — will hold on outbound customer messages until we confirm counts collapsed.
eva: quick root cause hypothesis: load balancer transient 502 + non-idempotent retries = duplicate emits. We'll verify LB metrics and retry logic.
incident-bot: Investigation ticket created: INC-5234. Timeline document: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-5234
alice: Current status — mitigation applied (proxy retry limit + emitter restart). Token rate reduced to ~30% above baseline, will watch for next 30m. No customer invoices issued. Handoff: I'll stay for 30m then hand to daytime oncall carla. If anyone needs to remain, speak now. :thumbsup:
carla: I'll take primary for business handoff after 30m. Planning postmortem and dedupe/backfill runbook.
ben: follow-up actions tracked in INC-5234, assigning: dedupe script (ben), backfill run (luis), billing reconciliation (carla), support comms (dean).
alice: closing live pager — moving to follow-up thread. last: 6509876820
incident-bot: Pager closed by alice at 2026-03-17T11:27:00Z. Follow-up assigned. :white_check_mark:
